decisions.reason: Omitting the sensor logic-level shifter does not change the established connector inventory, connector count, module pinouts, or sensor supply assignments.
The source confirms SPS30 logic compatibility but does not change the requirement to connect its SEL pin to GND for I2C mode.
The interboard connector types, power topology, signal pinout, and cable interface remain unchanged when the separate sensor-board level-shifter footprints are omitted.
Removing logic-level-shifter footprints does not change which power rails are measured, the monitoring IC, or measurement coverage.
The decision concerns sensor signal logic and does not alter the standalone regulator, its capacity, activation condition, or powered 3.3V load.
The source explicitly addresses sensor interfaces and their optional BSS138 level shifting, not the independently established LED supply and data-drive behavior.
Omission of the optional sensor logic-level shifter does not change the established I2C pull-up resistance, pull-up location, bus speed, cable length, or series-resistor policy.
The sensor-level-shifter decision does not affect the separate LED power-switching topology, control GPIO, or standby-current requirement.
SPS30 and ZE08 remain 5V-powered loads even though their logic is 3.3V-compatible, so the switched 5V sensor rail remains valid unchanged.
The level-shifter omission does not alter the DCDC1 configured voltage, target rail voltage, or Schottky-drop compensation requirement.
The sensor-interface logic decision is unrelated to the ESP32 BOOT button, reset connection, or associated capacitance values.
Saving board space by omitting the level-shifter footprints does not necessarily change any established board orientation, connector placement, alignment, routing, or accessibility constraint.
